title: An odd-period product for focal inversions of outer billiard polygons
description: For a fixed odd least-period elliptic billiard family with a strictly nested nondegenerate confocal elliptical caustic, we prove constancy of the product of the signed straight-edge areas obtained by unit inversion of the outer tangent-polygon vertices about the two original billiard foci. Every admissible coprime star turning number, the critical triangular case and fixed repeated traversals are included. This proves the assertion conjectured as k904,a in Reznik--Garcia--Koiller arXiv2004.12497v11, Table10 (earlier v10 label k808,a). The proof gives the explicit inverse-edge factorization, cancels double principal parts in the cyclic area sum, and applies the classical complementary zero/pole divisor argument on a compact torus. Stachel canonical coordinates, established Jacobi and cyclic elliptic identities, and earlier complex billiard and complementary-area techniques are credited. Original-vertex inverse areas and outer-locus-focus inversions are distinct targets. No exact earlier general proof was verified in two independent bounded priority audits; historical novelty remains undetermined. The final journal text of The talented Mr. Inversive Triangle was subscription-limited, open author versions were read, and selected-passage and unresolved-source limitations are preserved. No first-proof, absolute-priority, new general elliptic-method or current-worldwide-open claim is made. The deposit includes a concise research note and a portable source/verification archive preserving original submissions, exact controls, separately labeled numerical diagnostics and authored audit records. Finite checks support rather than replace the universal proof. AI tools were used extensively in solving, writing, computation, source investigation and independent internal adversarial checking. This is an unrefereed preprint without independent human peer review or formal proof-assistant verification.
